title: biatec_action authorization detail
description: RFC 9396 authorization_details object of any other action a relying party asks the user to confirm: a title and up to eight label and value lines the app renders itself (protocol 1.2, spec section 3.5). Every string is untrusted text under the text rules of spec section 15 (relying-party profile). `origin` is added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, never by the relying party.

origin.description: Added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, as the relying party reported it; part of the hashed object.
